structural_law: The geometric projection part of the new-layer morphism is closed on the same C_P formal unit: lifting to Q'=rQ cannot create support outside the old projection. The analytic-to-combinatorial part is also deterministic: a large new-layer Fourier coefficient on the r-fiber slices to a phase cap with comparable signed mass discrepancy. What remains is not the projection or Fourier step, but formal PDEC admission: the cap must be registered with the same Omega,tau,w, must be non-tautological and cap-stable, and its lower and upper budgets must be computed in that same unit.
